en.tagline: Read, search and edit Obsidian vaults from the command line
en.summary: This skill lets an agent or script work with Obsidian vaults. A vault is a normal folder of Markdown notes, and the skill uses the obsidian-cli tool to search, create, move and delete notes. Moving a note also updates the links that point to it.
problem: An Obsidian vault is a plain folder on disk, and many people have more than one vault. A script that guesses the wrong vault can change the wrong notes.
Renaming a note with a plain file move breaks its [[wikilinks]] and Markdown links. The skill reads the vault list from Obsidian's config, and uses obsidian-cli so that moves also update links.
fit: Scripts that search note text or note names in a local vault
Agents that create or edit notes for a user who keeps notes in Obsidian
Renaming or moving notes without breaking links
unfit: Changing files in the .obsidian/ config folder, which the skill says to avoid
Creating notes in hidden dot-folders through the Obsidian URI handler, which Obsidian may refuse
steps: Find the active vault by reading the entry with "open": true in obsidian.json, or run `obsidian-cli print-default`.
Set a default vault once with `obsidian-cli set-default "<vault-folder-name>"`.
Search note names with `obsidian-cli search "query"` or note text with `obsidian-cli search-content "query"`.
Create a note with `obsidian-cli create "Folder/New note" --content "..." --open`, which needs the Obsidian URI handler.
Move or rename a note with `obsidian-cli move`, which also updates wikilinks and Markdown links.
Edit a .md file directly when that fits, since Obsidian picks up the change.

zh.tagline: 从命令行读取、搜索和编辑 Obsidian 库
zh.summary: 这个技能让智能体或脚本能够操作 Obsidian 笔记库。笔记库就是一个普通的 Markdown 笔记文件夹。技能通过 obsidian-cli 搜索、创建、移动和删除笔记。移动笔记时，指向它的链接也会一并更新。
problem: Obsidian 笔记库就是磁盘上的普通文件夹，很多人同时有好几个库。脚本如果猜错了库，就可能改错笔记。
直接用文件移动功能给笔记改名，会破坏它的 [[双链]] 和 Markdown 链接。本技能从 Obsidian 的配置文件读取库列表，并通过 obsidian-cli 移动笔记，使链接同步更新。
fit: 在本地笔记库中按笔记名或正文搜索的脚本
替用户在 Obsidian 中创建或编辑笔记的智能体
需要重命名或移动笔记、又不想破坏链接的场景
unfit: 修改 .obsidian/ 配置目录中的文件，本技能建议避免这样做
通过 Obsidian URI 处理器在以点开头的隐藏文件夹中创建笔记，Obsidian 可能会拒绝
steps: 读取 obsidian.json 中 "open": true 的库条目，或运行 `obsidian-cli print-default` 找到当前库。
运行一次 `obsidian-cli set-default "<库文件夹名>"` 设置默认库。
用 `obsidian-cli search "关键词"` 按笔记名搜索，或用 `obsidian-cli search-content "关键词"` 搜索笔记正文。
用 `obsidian-cli create "文件夹/新笔记" --content "..." --open` 创建笔记，这需要 Obsidian URI 处理器可用。
用 `obsidian-cli move` 移动或重命名笔记，同时会更新双链和 Markdown 链接。
在合适的情况下直接编辑 .md 文件，Obsidian 会自动读取修改。
